description: List files in a Hugging Face model, dataset, or space repository.

path.description: Optional subdirectory path within the repository to list files under.

repo_id.description: The repository identifier (e.g. 'owner/name') whose files to list.

repo_type.description: Optional repository type selecting the namespace: 'models', 'datasets', or 'spaces' (default 'models'; singular forms are also accepted).

revision.description: Optional revision (branch, tag, or commit) whose file tree to list (default 'main').

name: list_repo_files
